method: Hours, prices, closures and booking rules read from each venue's own official page on 2026-11-25. Values not printed on the official page are left null and flagged U-xx rather than guessed. Social handles are only included when the account was opened and visibly confirmed to belong to the venue (see flag S-01 for the trap this avoids).

rows.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met Fifth Avenue)
rows.exceptions: New York State residents and NY/NJ/CT students pay what they wish (min $0.01).
rows.price: Adults $30 · Seniors 65+ $22 · Students $17 · Children 12 and under free · Members free
rows.price_note: Two adult general-admission tickets = $60 before tax.
rows.booking: Tickets sold online via engage.metmuseum.org or at the door.
rows.notes: Admission table and address verified. Public gallery hours are NOT printed anywhere on the captured page (only garage hours, which are a different thing) — left blank deliberately instead of copying typical hours from memory. Flagged A-01.

rows.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
rows.exceptions: Open every day except Thanksgiving and Christmas. Galleries close ~15 min before the museum. UNIQLO Friday Nights: free for New York State residents 17:30–20:30, ticket must be reserved in advance. MoMA PS1 (22-25 Jackson Ave, Queens) is free for everyone.
rows.price: Adults $30 · Seniors 65+ $22 · Students $17 (full-time, incl. international) · 16 and under free · Members free
rows.price_note: Two adult tickets = $60; includes all galleries and special exhibitions.
rows.booking: Timed tickets at visit.moma.org; CityPASS C3 accepted.
rows.notes: Full weekly hours, both closures and all ticket tiers read directly from moma.org/visit.

rows.name: American Museum of Natural History
rows.address: 200 Central Park West, New York, NY 10024
rows.exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Extended hours on select dates (published as a dated list, e.g. Saturdays to 20:00). Before 10:00 or after 17:00 use the Central Park West / 81st St (Rose Center) entrances. Temporary hall closures are published weekly.
rows.price_note: Admission prices were not captured on the hours page — see A-02.
rows.notes: Hours, closures and entrance rules verified. Ticket price intentionally left blank rather than assumed.

rows.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island National Monuments
rows.address: Liberty Island / Ellis Island (ferry from Battery Park, Manhattan)
rows.exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving Day (Nov 26, 2026) and Christmas Day (Dec 25, 2026). Last entrance into the statue itself is 15:30. Liberty Island Information Center 09:30–16:30 daily. Access is by Statue City Cruises ferry only.
rows.price_note: NPS does not price the ferry; Statue City Cruises sells it. Grounds are free, ferry and crown/museum tickets are not — see A-03.
rows.notes: Hours and both holiday closures verified from nps.gov (page last updated 2026-04-06). Ferry pricing is a third-party product, left blank.

rows.name: National September 11 Memorial & Museum
rows.exceptions: Museum closed Tuesdays except select Tuesdays — check the special-hours page for the exact February 2027 dates. Last museum entry 17:30. Advance ticket purchase is required. The Memorial itself is free and open daily 08:00–20:00, seven days a week.
rows.price_note: Museum ticket price not printed on the visit page — see A-04.
rows.notes: Six-day opening pattern, hours, last entry, advance-ticket rule and the free Memorial hours verified. Tuesday exceptions are date-specific and must be re-checked for the trip week.

rows.name: Central Park
rows.exceptions: Opens 06:00, closes 01:00, every day of the year. The Central Park Zoo restroom requires a zoo ticket; all other Conservancy restrooms are free.
rows.booking: None needed; some tours and the Davis Center ice rink are ticketed separately.
rows.notes: Hours verified on centralparknyc.org. Getting-here guidance is published by the Conservancy (M1/M2/M3 up Madison; 19-min walk from Grand Central).

rows.name: The High Line
rows.address: Gansevoort St to 34th St, west of 10th Ave
rows.exceptions: Seasonal: 1 April–30 November 07:00–22:00; 1 December–31 March 07:00–20:00 — the February trip falls in the SHORT winter window. The Rail Yard Preserve (30th–34th St) closes at dusk. No dogs, bikes, scooters or alcohol; wheelchair loan needs one business day's notice.
rows.price_note: Public park, no admission; free docent-led tours on select days.
rows.booking: None for entry; tours via the schedule page.
rows.notes: Winter closing at 20:00 is the key planning constraint for a February visit — captured verbatim from the visitor page.

rows.name: Top of the Rock Observation Deck
rows.exceptions: Timed admission — you choose a date and entry time. Weather can close the outdoor terraces.
rows.price: From $42 timed admission · All-Inclusive Pass (deck + The Beam + SKYLIFT) from $82
rows.price_note: Two timed-admission tickets from $84; 'from' pricing, date-dependent.
rows.notes: Opening hours and both published ticket tiers captured. Sunset slots sell out — book the timed entry early.

rows.name: NYPL Stephen A. Schwarzman Building (Rose Main Reading Room)
rows.exceptions: Last entry to the building is 15 minutes before closure. Rose Main Reading Room 'visiting hour' is 10:00–11:00 Monday–Saturday (final entry 10:50); outside that hour you need a free tour booking or a research reason. The Polonsky Treasures exhibition is on site. Midtown renovation work is ongoing — expect noise.
rows.price_note: Free entry; the Treasures exhibition is free.
rows.notes: Visiting-hour rule and last-entry rule verified. The page says 'see building hours above' but the hours widget did not render in the captured text, so the daily open/close times are deliberately blank — flag A-05.

rows.name: Katz's Delicatessen
rows.address: 205 East Houston Street, New York, NY 10002
rows.exceptions: Breakfast specials served until 11:30. No free refills. Cash-and-card accepted; ticket system at the counter.
rows.price: Pastrami sandwich $30.95 · Reuben $31.95 · Matzo ball soup $10.95 · Latkes $17.45 · Dinner Platter $38.95
rows.price_note: Two pastrami sandwiches = $61.90 before drinks; a couple realistically spends $70–90 with sides and drinks.
rows.notes: Menu prices verified line by line from the official in-store menu. Opening hours are not printed on the menu page — blank + flag A-06. (Do not confuse the shipping-store prices on the homepage with in-store prices.)

flags: A-01 … A-06: items where the venue's own page does not state the value (Met public hours, AMNH ticket price, Statue of Liberty ferry price, 9/11 museum price, NYPL daily hours, Katz's opening hours). These are shown as blank with an 'unverified' chip rather than copied from secondary sources.
The High Line's winter hours (07:00–20:00, 1 Dec–31 Mar) shorten February sightseeing days; plan outdoor walks before 20:00.
The 9/11 Museum is closed most Tuesdays — if the trip lands on a Tuesday, swap in MoMA (open daily) or the Met.
Social-media handles for ACTIVITIES remain unverified. Rather than guess a handle (see the @crownshy trap in flag S-01), the social columns are blank pending review.
